commands:
set -e
sudo cp /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf.bak.$(date +%s)
echo "=== BEFORE ==="
sudo grep -nE "PublicKey|AllowedIPs|^\[" /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf || true
sudo python3 <<'PY'
import re
p="/etc/wireguard/wg0.conf"
text=open(p).read()
NEW="WUy9mL/EJ3dtaG61S4l+YK8yzX9TV0I3PzCGiO2yPGI="
STALE="uxk1J7dG3HHL7E/T8CWCE0PZUwObsC7XCGKQK5OsCAg="
IP="10.10.0.3/32"
parts=re.split(r'(?m)^(?=\[)', text)
out=[]
for b in parts:
    if not b.strip():
        out.append(b); continue
    if b.lstrip().startswith("[Peer]"):
        if STALE in b:
            print("DROP stale"); continue
        if NEW in b:
            if "AllowedIPs" in b:
                b=re.sub(r'(?m)^AllowedIPs\s*=.*$', f"AllowedIPs = {IP}", b)
            else:
                b=b.rstrip()+f"\nAllowedIPs = {IP}\n"
            print("FIXED current peer")
    out.append(b)
new="".join(out)
if NEW not in new:
    new+=f"\n[Peer]\nPublicKey = {NEW}\nAllowedIPs = {IP}\n"
    print("APPENDED new peer")
open(p,"w").write(new)
PY
echo "=== AFTER ==="
sudo grep -nE "PublicKey|AllowedIPs|^\[" /etc/wireguard/wg0.conf
echo "=== RELOAD ==="
sudo bash -c "wg syncconf wg0 <(wg-quick strip wg0)"
echo "=== STATUS ==="
sudo wg show wg0
